goal_intent: insist that last time was so bad that this table must be free, and refuse to give any details until that is promised

turns.utterance: Yeah, I’m calling because last time was such a disaster that I want a free table this Friday.
No, I’m not giving you any more details until you guarantee this one is free—I’m not wasting my time again.
Fine, transfer me, but I’m telling you, if they don’t sort this right now, I’ll leave a review and ask for the manager.
I already said, I want a free table or there’s no booking—otherwise, forget it.
Two people, 8pm, but again, only if it’s free because of last time.
Not unless you confirm it’s free—if not, I’m done here.
So you’re saying it’s completely free, no charge at all for the meal? Confirm that right now or cancel it.
Cancel it then. I’m not coming unless it’s free. [END OF CALL]
